name: My Town News
_emailNote: Two addresses, two jobs. `email` is where readers write to us and appears on about, advertise, submit-tip, privacy and in the footer. `senderEmail` is the From line Buttondown puts on outgoing mail — it must match the verified sending domain, which is the subdomain mail.mytown.news, so it cannot be the same string. Telling a reader to watch for the wrong one sends them looking for an email that will never arrive.
description: Hyperlocal weekly news for every San Francisco neighborhood. Free, independent, community-focused.
